extraction: MARS (Multi-Agent Review System): multiple LLM agents review code independently, aggregate via voting. Reviewer agents: Security, Performance, Correctness, Style. Maps to our santa-method: Reviewer 1 (mechanism) ≈ Correctness + Style, Reviewer 2 (outcome) ≈ Performance + Security. But MARS uses N reviewers (costly), santa-method uses 2 (our Verdict dual-pass). MARS needs paid LLM calls — violates our no-paid-keys. santa-method fits our harness.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: confirms santa-method (2 reviewers) > MARS (N reviewers) for our no-paid-keys constraint
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
